title: P15.9-A1: canonical read-only Company Cockpit projections (cockpit + reviews + company) on owner-scoped vnext routes
description: P15.9-A1 on BASE e24e334 (post PR #90): backend canonical read-only projections for the Company Cockpit — no UI, no owner mutations (A2 deferred by owner decision). ObjectiveCockpitService composes EXISTING strict reads only: objectives.get + buildReviewObservation (KPI/budget/binding/WAL/mission re-proved, throws on corruption) + canonicalAdaptiveReviewsFor + boundMissionForWorkItem + filtered artifact refs. New GET routes: /api/vnext/objectives/:id/cockpit, /:id/reviews?limit=, /api/vnext/businesses/:id/company. Authority = same owner-scope contract as auto-policy routes: actor from x-operator-id only; owner_authority_id match required; foreign objective -> FAIL_CLOSED_COCKPIT_AUTHORITY (403); actor owning nothing in business -> FAIL_CLOSED_COMPANY_SCOPE (403); missing header -> 403; tampered canonical state -> FAIL_CLOSED* (409). Read-only: no store.put/event reachable; board()/detail() avoided (they fold on read). Selective fields only — no raw rows, no storage paths/secrets. buildReviewObservation narrowed to Omit<deps,'ceoCycle'> (never read on read path; no semantic change). TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE never conflated with objective.status ACHIEVED. Suite pair-p15-9a-company-cockpit.test.ts: 11 tests — projection truth, multi-objective scope, foreign/non-owner denial, tamper fail-closed, ordering/bounds, CANDIDATE!=ACHIEVED, MET+incomplete-workstream honesty, no-write invariant, real-server 403s. Regressions 211 green. No merge/deploy.
